verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents an AI troubleshooting assistant that users query in natural language for device-specific answers and insights, and markets Tia as an AI agent that helps fix IT issues. However, the evidence describes natural-language querying and insight retrieval, not actually operating the product (initiating sessions, running scripts, managing devices) through natural-language commands. The voice commands mentioned for smart-glasses workflows are framed as hands-free operation, not natural-language control. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command execution of product actions, details of what Tia can do on command, independent or hands-on corroboration.
